description:
Two coverage gaps:

1. No live-Anthropic integration test for `mix pi --print "..."`.
   Phase 2 has one (`apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/
   integration_test.exs`); Phase 3 should too. Tag `:integration`,
   excluded by default, opt-in via
   `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... mix test --only integration`.

   Trivial prompt: "Echo the string 'hello' exactly" with tools
   disabled. Assert stdout contains "hello", exit code 0.

2. No end-to-end RPC test. The opi-dkl.1 fix covers
   subscribe-target + event-drain; follow up here with a true
   E2E that simulates a client sending JSON lines and asserts
   both response + event lines arrive on stdout.

   Use StringIO for stdin, CaptureIO for stdout, drive a full
   prompt-through-AgentEnd flow against FakeTransport.

TDD:
- Live Anthropic integration test lands with `:integration` tag.
- RPC E2E test lands without tag, runs in default suite.

Depends on opi-dkl.1.
title: Integration + E2E tests: live Anthropic Print + RPC flow
